proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate / per-grant class-level threshold
proposed_widenings.justification: The Fiend Spells table grants different spells at warlock levels 3, 5, 7, and 9. PassiveMechanics.grants is a flat unconditional list — there is no mechanism to gate individual grants on reaching a minimum class level. The L5/7/9 rows (Fireball, Stinking Cloud; Fire Shield, Wall of Fire; Geas, Insect Plague) cannot be represented without a per-grant level predicate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared

notes: The L3 row (Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion) encodes cleanly as passive grant_spell_access(prepared). The full feature spans levels 3/5/7/9; encoding only L3 is honest for this slug but incomplete for the feature as a whole. The gap is in PassiveMechanics: grants have no per-entry class-level threshold variant — EquipmentPredicate covers equipment state only, not character/class level advancement.
